paired_comparison.method: paired nonoverlapping seven-day calendar-block percentile bootstrap
paired_comparison.limitation: approximate descriptive intervals; few blocks, inter-week dependence, historical design and possible pretraining contamination remain; two-sided 97.5% intervals are Bonferroni-adjusted for the two primary horizon comparisons only

gate.meaning: predefined historical evidence gate; does not establish prospective or profitable performance
